purpose: Reconstruct high-value practical concepts after GDF3 freeze without promoting them back into foundations.

representationForms.semantic_alias: Human/Agent-facing name that expands to lower semantic relations; no independent truth authority.
representationForms.derived_query_view: Recomputable projection over authoritative lower state/relations.
representationForms.typed_operational_record: Persisted operational object justified by identity/currentness/audit/coordination needs; semantics remain traceable to lower sources.
representationForms.workflow_object: Persisted lifecycle object coordinating multi-step work such as review, appeal or delegation.
representationForms.policy_surface: Declarative practice policy or constraint interpreted over frozen semantic relations.
representationForms.ui_authoring_projection: Lossy but useful presentation/editor abstraction with explicit drill-down to source semantics.
representationForms.audit_trace: Evidence/provenance/history projection supporting explanation and audit rather than becoming WorldTruth.
representationForms.local_pattern: Reusable GameForm-specific recipe; not a cross-Game mandatory concept.

reconstructionContract: practicalPurpose: what authoring/query/operation/explanation cost the abstraction reduces
semanticSources: frozen F/GDF relations from which the abstraction derives
hiddenDistinctions: what the convenient concept intentionally suppresses
authorityRule: what the concept is and is not allowed to imply about binding authority
currentnessRule: how scope/version/time invalidates or changes the projection
persistenceRule: derived by default; persist only for identity/workflow/history/performance needs
drillDownRule: Human and Agent tooling must be able to recover the authoritative lower semantics when correctness matters
ownerBoundary: identify Game vs World/Media/Human/Social/GeneralReasoning ownership

tiers.T1_cross_game_toolkit: High recurring utility across many GameForms; stable practical abstraction justified.
tiers.T2_conditional_toolkit: Reusable across a substantial family of GameForms but instantiated only when the form/practice needs it.
tiers.T3_ui_authoring_vocabulary: Useful cognitive compression for users/designers/Agents, but intentionally lossy and never authoritative by identity.
tiers.T4_local_or_caution: Keep local/descriptive unless repeated concrete utility justifies broader stabilization.

concepts.name: RoleAssignment
hiddenDistinctions: role label does not imply authority
concepts.reason: Roles are an ergonomic coordination surface for humans and Agents; assignment identity/currentness often needs persistence.

concepts.name: ScopedAuthorityEdge
concepts.reason: Highest-value operational representation from GDF3-B; directly supports admission, delegation, audit and Agent authority manifests.

concepts.name: AuthorityProfile
hiddenDistinctions: profile is a projection, not an authority object
different operations may have incomparable scopes
concepts.reason: Compresses many authority edges into an inspectable Human/Agent view without introducing hierarchy.

concepts.name: AgentAuthorityManifest
hiddenDistinctions: model identity does not imply authority
concepts.reason: Agent-first systems need one compact way to answer what this Agent may propose/decide/change/enforce now.

concepts.name: RoleCausalAccessProfile
concepts.reason: Excellent permission/debugging/authoring view across Player, Agent, spectator, coach and operator roles.

concepts.name: ParticipationAuthorityTopology
hiddenDistinctions: not a tree or global hierarchy
concepts.reason: Very useful system map for debugging and design, but should never be canonical stored authority truth.

concepts.name: AuthoritySeparationPolicy
hiddenDistinctions: separation-of-duties is practice-specific, not universal law
concepts.reason: Lets a GamePractice express constraints such as rule-change holder cannot review own case without pretending separation is ontological.

concepts.name: DelegationGrant
hiddenDistinctions: delegation does not transfer unspecified operations
concepts.reason: Although Delegation is not a primitive, a durable grant/revoke workflow is extremely useful for Agent/player/operator coordination.

concepts.name: AppointmentReplacementRecord
concepts.reason: Useful in tournaments, organizations, persistent worlds and delegated Agent systems.

concepts.name: AuthoritativeDeterminationRecord
concepts.reason: Natural practical instantiation of frozen GDF3 when independently meaningful binding case status exists.

concepts.name: DeterminationBasisTrace
hiddenDistinctions: basis trace need not be full reasoning trace
concepts.reason: Supports explanation/review/currentness without forcing universal EvidenceSet or rationale storage.

concepts.name: CaseDeterminationBoundaryDiagnostic
hiddenDistinctions: diagnostic result is not a new object
concepts.reason: Prevents ordinary deterministic execution from being over-modeled as adjudication and detects missing case-status structure.

concepts.name: ReviewRequest
concepts.reason: Review is not primitive, but a request lifecycle is a very useful workflow object where contestability exists.

concepts.name: AppealRequest
concepts.reason: High utility for tournament/institutional practices but too narrow for universal Game core.

concepts.name: ReviewContestabilityProfile
concepts.reason: Excellent design/UX/tooling view for what can be reviewed, by whom, until when and with what effects.

concepts.name: DecisionLineage
hiddenDistinctions: lineage is reconstructed history, not primitive
concepts.reason: Very high audit/explanation value and cheap to derive from durable events.

concepts.name: EvidenceBundleForCase
concepts.reason: Extremely useful in review/moderation/tournament workflows, but dangerous unless explicitly relational to a case/question.

concepts.name: NormApplicationView
concepts.reason: Excellent explanation/audit surface for adjudication-heavy or mutable-rule practices.

concepts.name: InterpretiveCommitment
concepts.reason: Useful whenever stable text + changing adopted interpretation affects future Game semantics.

concepts.name: PrecedentLink
concepts.reason: Useful in tournament/community/rules practice and Agent retrieval, but must encode current status/relevance rather than raw prior-case identity.

concepts.name: ConventionStatusView
concepts.reason: Useful to compare common practice with officially adopted practice, especially communities/live games.

concepts.name: DiscretionEnvelope
concepts.reason: Very useful for bounded Agent/judge behavior, design tests and policy inspection.

concepts.name: EnforcementRecord
hiddenDistinctions: failed enforcement does not erase ruling
concepts.reason: Operationally useful to record what consequence was attempted/applied while preserving separation from case status.

concepts.name: RemedyPlan
concepts.reason: Useful where decisions require corrective actions, sanctions, restarts or record repair.

concepts.name: ParticipantView
concepts.reason: Excellent human vocabulary and list/filter concept; dangerous only if persisted as ontology.

concepts.name: SpectatorView
concepts.reason: Strong UX/query term for observational roles while preserving causal access details underneath.

concepts.name: AudienceView
concepts.reason: Useful presentation concept for streams/judged/voted play, but should not imply collective agency.

concepts.name: RefereeJudgeRoleBundle
hiddenDistinctions: judge label does not specify review/rule-change/enforcement authority
concepts.reason: Very useful reusable bundle for sports/tournaments/judged games without making Judge a primitive.

concepts.name: GameMasterRoleBundle
hiddenDistinctions: GM is a bundle, not one atomic role
same holder can possess only a subset
concepts.reason: High practical value for TTRPG/generative games; should be a composable preset over explicit capabilities/authorities.

concepts.name: CoachAdvisorRoleBundle
concepts.reason: Useful for assistive, party, coaching and Agent companion designs.

concepts.name: ModeratorRoleBundle
hiddenDistinctions: platform authority may be outside Game scope
concepts.reason: High value for social/live games and Agent-assisted moderation with explicit owner boundaries.

concepts.name: OperatorRoleBundle
hiddenDistinctions: operations authority does not imply case authority
concepts.reason: Useful for live operations/tournament/platform control when scope is explicit.

concepts.name: ExperienceManagerRoleBundle
concepts.reason: Useful for directors/adaptive systems while preserving separation from Player and Judge concepts.

concepts.name: RuleStandardLabels
hiddenDistinctions: rule vs standard is not universal binary
both may be open/closed to different degrees
concepts.reason: Useful writing/design vocabulary but too misleading for canonical schema categories.

concepts.name: FinalityStatus
concepts.reason: Very useful UI shorthand such as current/final/appealable, provided it is derived from current review topology.

concepts.name: OfficialStatusCertificationView
concepts.reason: High-value player/operator concept for records, results, eligibility and judged status.

concepts.name: VerificationView
hiddenDistinctions: verification result may be evidence for a case
concepts.reason: Already useful in current engineering; should remain a strong practical evidence surface while never silently becoming official case determination.

priorityClusters.name: Operational Role & Authority Toolkit
priorityClusters.why: Broadest cross-Game and Agent-first leverage; reduces permissions/authority/role ambiguity and supports many later practical concepts.

priorityClusters.name: Case Determination & Contestability Toolkit
priorityClusters.why: Directly operationalizes frozen GDF3 without over-modeling; crucial for tournaments, moderation, judged play, certification and open Agent action.

priorityClusters.name: Evidence / Norm / Explanation Toolkit
priorityClusters.why: High audit and explainability value but larger misuse risk; should build on P1/P2 semantics rather than precede them.

priorityClusters.name: Enforcement / Remedy Toolkit
priorityClusters.why: Operationally important but downstream of determinations and ordinary transition semantics.

priorityClusters.name: Role Bundle Templates
priorityClusters.why: Large ergonomic gain for authoring and Agent configuration once P1 authority primitives/views are stable.

priorityClusters.name: Human/Agent Vocabulary Views
priorityClusters.why: Very useful cognitive compression, but mostly presentation/query vocabulary rather than operational source of truth.

selection.reason: P1 has highest combined cross-Game reuse, Agent utility, dependency leverage and low-to-moderate misuse risk. It provides the substrate on which review, role bundles, moderation, GM, delegation and case workflows can be rebuilt cleanly.
